preRegisteredFalsifiers: F1 - A check that passes on zero matched inputs has proved nothing. Violation: the instrument prints its matched-input counts and REFUSES a verdict when a predicate matched nothing ('A check with no inputs is worse than no check'). Measured on the built surfaces: bodies=5, badges=6, cells=134, fonts=258, roster=20, builtOnContrast=8. It does not refuse.

F2 - A pass on the design boards does not satisfy the row, because those boards pass before the change. Violation: the row is met with the --dir reader on the BUILT surfaces, and the artifact prints the design-board run separately and labels it 'evidence about the folder, not about the surface'.

F3 - The instrument must be shown able to FAIL, in both directions, for THIS surface. Violation: 11 planted violations, 11 refused, each planted into a copy of the built export: a headline in the built-surface voice, a 24px data-font figure, a vendor gate, an invented state word, a badge reading 'Not read', a roster count for parks, a roster count for public works, a person in a cell, the composer sentence paraphrased, the scope marker renamed, and the contrast board dropping the composer. The unmutated export passes as the control, and the design folder is asserted unchanged after the run.

F4 - The shipped surface must not carry the built-surface vocabulary, and 'checked by eye' is not a check. Violation: a FILE-level scan of web/index.html's Parks section and of the four exported surfaces reports tableOrTile=0, vocabTerms=0/9, composer=verbatim, and the same scan is demonstrated able to fire by planting a table, a data-metric tile and a vocabulary term into copies.

F5 - A merge ships nothing, so reachability may not be inferred from the PR. Violation: both DO apps were probed over the network with the edge headers recorded; /lens/parks is 404 on both with x-do-orig-status 404, and the clause is named as needing a merge plus a planner-owned deployment rather than reported as reached.
theHardestPartAndWhyItIsTheRow: The instrument's two-sided rule is what makes this row safe to build at all: Main is clean of the built-surface vocabulary and Difference deliberately carries it, so 'this surface does not exist' is a claim an instrument can hold a page to. The build therefore had to land on the CLEAN side of that boundary while still naming the reasons -- which is why the surface prints the refusal messages, the absence basis and the roster counts, and why it prints no count, no gate word and no region for itself.
whatCouldHaveGoneWrongAndDidNot: Registering the domain to make the page 'render' would have given the page a region and made every sentence on it false. Not done; asserted absent.
Filling the page from a near miss (the map layer, the role, the register row) would have answered a different question. Each is named on the surface as not-this-lens instead.

Adding the lens to the shell as a ninth built lens with a 'waiting for a source' state would have turned 'does not exist' into 'exists and is unfed', which is the exact defect class the dispatch opens with.
